units.text: 3. The Government of the Russian Federation shall approve the list of electronic platform operators that meet the requirements established by points 1 and 2 of part 2 of this Article and the list of specialized electronic platform operators that meet the requirements established by points 1 and 3 of part 2 of this Article. An electronic platform operator or specialized electronic platform operator shall be removed from the respective list under the procedure provided for by point 5 of part 2 of this Article if it fails to meet one or more requirements of points 1 and 2 or points 1 and 3 of part 2 of this Article, respectively, or requests removal. An electronic platform or specialized electronic platform whose operator has been removed from the relevant list may continue electronic procedures or closed electronic procedures for which notices were published in the unified information system or invitations were sent no later than ten working days after the Government of the Russian Federation decided to remove the operator from the relevant list.

units.locator: Article 24.2. Registration of procurement participants in the unified information system and their accreditation on electronic platforms and specialized electronic platforms. Unified register of procurement participants

units.locator: Article 24.2. Registration of procurement participants in the unified information system and their accreditation on electronic platforms and specialized electronic platforms. Unified register of procurement participants
units.text: 1. Procurement participants shall be registered in the unified information system electronically on the basis of information and documents, in the manner and within the time limits determined by the Government of the Russian Federation. Information and documents on registered participants shall be entered in the unified register of procurement participants.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 24.2

units.locator: Article 24.2. Registration of procurement participants in the unified information system and their accreditation on electronic platforms and specialized electronic platforms. Unified register of procurement participants
units.text: 2. Requiring information or documents other than those provided for by the Government of the Russian Federation under part 1 of this Article for registration of procurement participants in the unified information system is prohibited. Charging procurement participants for such registration is prohibited.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 24.2

units.locator: Article 24.2. Registration of procurement participants in the unified information system and their accreditation on electronic platforms and specialized electronic platforms. Unified register of procurement participants
units.text: 3. Offshore companies may not be registered as procurement participants in the unified information system.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 24.2

units.locator: Article 24.2. Registration of procurement participants in the unified information system and their accreditation on electronic platforms and specialized electronic platforms. Unified register of procurement participants
units.text: 4. Electronic platform operators shall accredit a procurement participant on the platform no later than the working day following its registration in the unified information system. Accreditation shall take place through information exchange between the platform and the unified information system and other state information systems, in accordance with requirements established under part 2 of Article 24.1 of this Federal Law. The operator may not require any documents and/or information from the participant for accreditation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 24.2

units.locator: Article 24.2. Registration of procurement participants in the unified information system and their accreditation on electronic platforms and specialized electronic platforms. Unified register of procurement participants
units.text: 4.1. An electronic platform operator shall maintain a register of procurement participants accredited on the platform, which must contain:

units.text: 12.1. To gain access to closed electronic procedures, a procurement participant accredited on a specialized electronic platform shall send its operator information and documents confirming compliance with the requirements provided for by point 1 of part 1 of Article 31 of this Federal Law, where such information and documents exist. If that information and those documents are held in open and publicly accessible state registers published on the Internet, the participant may instead send the operator the address of the website or webpage where they are published. In addition, to gain access to procurement on that specialized electronic platform whose participants are subject to additional requirements under parts 2 and 2.1 of Article 31 of this Federal Law, the participant may send the operator information and documents listed by the Government of the Russian Federation under part 3 of Article 31 of this Federal Law.

units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.label: Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: 1. Procurement of the same goods, works or services may be conducted through a joint tender or auction under an agreement concluded in accordance with this Article (hereinafter in this Article, the agreement). The provisions of this Federal Law on tenders and auctions shall apply subject to the following special rules:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: 1) the joint tender or auction shall be conducted by its organizer, which shall be one of the contracting authorities, authorized bodies or authorized institutions to which the others have transferred powers to conduct it under the agreement. After conclusion of the agreement and before procurement begins, those contracting authorities, authorized bodies or authorized institutions shall include information about the organizer in their schedules;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: 2) the procurement notice or invitation must contain the initial (maximum) price of each contract to be concluded following the joint tender or auction and the total of those prices; or, in the case provided for by part 24 of Article 22 of this Federal Law, the initial unit price of goods, works or services, the initial total of those unit prices and the maximum price of each contract to be concluded;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: 3) a procurement participant shall, following the procedure for submitting a contract price offer under this Federal Law, offer a total price for all contracts to be concluded following the joint tender or auction, reducing the total initial (maximum) prices determined under point 2 of this part. In the case provided for by part 24 of Article 22 of this Federal Law, the participant shall offer a total of unit prices of goods, works or services;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: 4) each party to the agreement shall conclude its contract following the joint tender or auction in the manner provided for by this Federal Law. Where a party is an authorized body exercising only powers to select suppliers (contractors, service providers) for a contracting authority, that contracting authority shall conclude the contract. The contract price shall be determined by reducing the relevant initial (maximum) price in proportion to the reduction in the total initial (maximum) prices of all contracts offered by the participant. In the case provided for by part 24 of Article 22 of this Federal Law, each draft contract shall include its maximum price and the unit price of goods, works or services, determined by reducing the initial unit price in proportion to the reduction in the initial total of unit prices offered by the participant with whom the contract is concluded;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: 5) each party to the agreement shall send the procurement control body a request for approval of conclusion of a contract with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) under this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: 2. The agreement shall be concluded in accordance with the Civil Code of the Russian Federation and this Federal Law before procurement begins and must contain:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: 1) information about the parties to the agreement, including the organizer of the joint tender or auction;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: 2) information about the procurement subject matter, and the place, time limits (periods) and other terms of supply, performance or provision for each contracting authority;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: 3) the initial (maximum) prices of each contract to be concluded following the joint tender or auction, or the initial unit prices of goods, works or services in the case provided for by part 24 of Article 22 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: 4) the rights, obligations and liability of the parties and the procedure for resolving disputes;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: 5) the procedure for forming the procurement commission;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: 6) information on the deadline for publishing the procurement notice or sending the invitation;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: 7) other information governing the relations between the parties.
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 25
